ability.lingeringaroma: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Lingering Aroma.
ability.seedsower: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves. Pokémon on the ground have their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and restore 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.
ability.thermalexchange: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
ability.angershell: When an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
ability.purifyingsalt: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
ability.wellbakedbody: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
ability.windrider: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
ability.guarddog: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
ability.rockypayload: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Rock-type moves by 50%.
ability.windpower: The Pokémon becomes charged when Tailwind takes effect or it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
ability.zerotohero: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.
ability.commander: Upon entering battle, the Pokémon goes inside an ally Dondozo if one is on the field and raises all its stats sharply. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Pokémon is on the field.
ability.electromorphosis: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the power of the next Electric-type move used by the Pokémon will be doubled.
ability.protosynthesis: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.
ability.quarkdrive: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.
ability.goodasgold: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.
ability.vesselofruin: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.
ability.swordofruin: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.
ability.tabletsofruin: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.
ability.beadsofruin: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.
ability.orichalcumpulse: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the power of Water-type moves. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.
ability.hadronengine: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up the Electric-type moves of Pokémon on the ground by 30% and prevents them from falling asleep. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.
ability.opportunist: When an opponent’s stats are boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost its own stats in the exact same way.
ability.cudchew: If the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate and eat that same Berry once more at the end of next turn.
ability.sharpness: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s slicing moves by 50%.
ability.supremeoverlord: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokémon in its party that has been defeated in battle already. The maximum boost is 50%
ability.costar: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies its ally’s stat changes.
ability.toxicdebris: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves. Opposing Pokémon that land on these spikes when switching into battle will be poisoned. A second layer of spikes will instead badly poison. Poison-types that land on these spikes will absorb and remove them from the field.
ability.armortail: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
ability.eartheater: Ground-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.
ability.myceliummight: The Pokémon’s status moves will go last among moves of the same priority, but these moves will be unaffected by the Ability of the target.
ability.mindseye: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents’ evasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
ability.supersweetsyrup: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field when the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.
ability.hospitality: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring 1/4 of its ally’s max HP.
ability.toxicchain: When the Pokémon hits a target with a move, the target has a 30% chance of being badly poisoned from the power of the Pokémon’s toxic chain.
ability.terashift: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
ability.terashell: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
ability.teraformzero: The Pokémon uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
ability.poisonpuppeteer: Pokémon poisoned or badly poisoned by this Pokémon’s moves will also become confused.
ability.piercingdrill: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.
ability.dragonize: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
ability.eelevate: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
ability.megasol: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
ability.firemane: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50%.
ability.spicyspray: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
ability.auraguard: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact.
ability.asoneglastrier: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Chilling Neigh, preventing opposing Pokémon from consuming berries and boosting the Pokémon’s Attack stat when knocking out a target.
ability.asonespectrier: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Grim Neigh, preventing opposing Pokémon from consuming berries and boosting the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when knocking out a target.
ability.embodyaspectteal: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Teal Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Speed stat to be boosted.
ability.embodyaspectwellspring: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Wellspring Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Sp. Def stat to be boosted.
ability.embodyaspecthearthflame: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Hearthflame Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Attack stat to be boosted.
ability.embodyaspectcornerstone: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Cornerstone Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Defense stat to be boosted.
